plugins.name: observational-memory
plugins.description: Observational memory beside compaction: an observer model notes what matters as the session runs, and after each compaction the notes are added after the harness's own summary; a recall tool returns the exact transcript lines behind a note

plugins.name: rpctool
plugins.description: Shrinks large tool results to head and tail with the full text saved to a file, and runs commands on allowlisted hosts over ssh through an MCP server

plugins.name: ordinator
plugins.description: Execution orchestration for a fleet of implementation sessions: one orchestrator skill that launches, relays and records; one implementation skill per ticket that plans, builds, reviews and opens a draft PR through the ticket-pr workflow; eleven stage agents with narrow tool surfaces. Configured per project by the setup skill.

plugins.name: agent-tmux
plugins.description: Stdio MCP server that lets an agent see and lay out its own tmux session: list, capture, new windows and splits, wait for output, and type into panes it owns without pressing Enter
